invoices.title: Customer invoices
invoices.emptyDescription: Invoice an order or create a direct invoice.

invoice.draftNotice: This document is a draft: it has no legal number yet, has not reduced stock and is not posted to the accounts.

payment.title: Collect invoice payment
payment.savedOfflineDescription: It will be applied to the invoice at the next sync.
payment.saved: Payment recorded: cash and accounting updated.

creditNote.title: Issue a credit note
creditNote.description: A validated invoice cannot be edited: corrections go through a credit note, which covers all the lines.
creditNote.issued: Credit note issued: reversing entry posted.

creditNotes.title: Credit notes
creditNotes.description: Corrections of validated invoices: reversing entry and stock return.
creditNotes.emptyDescription: Credit notes are issued from a validated invoice.

invoiceForm.title: New invoice
invoiceForm.description: A draft has no effect; validation reduces stock and posts to the accounts.
invoiceForm.warehouseHint: Determines which warehouse the stock leaves from.
invoiceForm.draftSavedOfflineDescription: It will be created on the server at the next sync.
invoiceForm.savedOfflineDescription: It will be validated (stock and accounting) at the next sync.
invoiceForm.validated: Invoice {{number}} validated: stock and accounting updated.
